caveats: These goals are derived benchmarks, not a reconciled operating plan. The solver's schedule creates more pipeline than the targets need, because pipeline created to fund one quarter also lands in later ones, so its own bookings are shown beside the targets; target-equivalent wins come from the target, not from the schedule. Ownership, segment and quota have no history in the files, so today's values stand in for the plan start. The fit's estimator is chosen by the report's declared rule, scored on back-test folds cut at the plan date from what was known then; where too few folds exist at that date the rule keeps the incumbent (matured snapshots). A quarter whose entered target is zero has no target-equivalent wins, so the schedule's created deals for that quarter are shared by trailing-year bookings instead.

The win-rate column is a dated benchmark, not a multiplier for the same period's created deals: it is the rate of the creation cohort old enough to have had its whole year, measured at the period's end (or the as-of date).

Segment forecasts share one pooled model out; no model is fitted to a slice, so the company back-test's credibility does not transfer to a segment. A behind cell is a planning discrepancy, not proof of a cause.

columns.definition: Deals open immediately before the period starts, a stock that is never added across quarters, with the fiscal year's opening snapshot as its goal.

columns.definition: Deals created in the period through the as-of date, with the creation still expected added for the forecast and the frozen creation schedule's requirement as the goal.
columns.title: Created deals

columns.definition: The first recorded ARR of the deals created in the period, with the pipeline still expected added for the forecast and the frozen schedule's requirement as the goal.
columns.title: Created pipeline

columns.definition: The share of deals created in the trailing year, old enough to have resolved, that were won, a dated benchmark and not a multiplier for the period's created deals, with the pooled rate as the forecast and the rate assumed at the plan start as the goal.
columns.title: Win rate, 365 days

columns.definition: Average days from creation to close for the period's wins, with the forecast blending actual wins and those still expected and the frozen schedule's implied cycle as the goal.
columns.title: Cycle

columns.definition: Deals won in the period, from pipeline carried in and from pipeline created in the period, with the wins still expected added for the forecast and the bookings target over the plan-start average won ARR as the goal.
columns.title: Won deals

columns.definition: Bookings divided by wins, with forecast bookings over forecast wins as the forecast, and unavailable when there are no wins.
columns.title: Average won ARR

columns.definition: Won ARR closed in the period, with the expected remainder added for the forecast and the entered target as the goal.

reasons.no_goal: There is no goal here, or it is zero, so there is nothing to compare with.
reasons.not_modeled: This period has not begun, so this figure is not modeled for it.
reasons.too_few: Too few observations stand behind this ratio for a stable comparison.
reasons.vacuous: For a period that has begun the forecast is the recorded fact, which is also the basis the goal was frozen from, so the comparison carries no information.
